})();

					const maxAge = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60
					date.setTime(date.getTime() + maxAge * 1000)
					const expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString()
					const cookieValuePair = 'useMobileSite=' + value
					document.cookie = cookieValuePair + expires + '; path=/; maxAge=' + maxAge

					if (document.cookie.includes(cookieValuePair)) {
						window.location.reload(true)
					} else {
						console.error('Failed to set useMobileSite cookie.')
					}
				}

				/*
				 * If ?fromApp=true, it's possible for user is already in the correct mode, so only try
				 * reloading if that's the case. In fact, trying to reload the page regardless causes an 
				 * infinite loop as the ?fromApp=true parameter is always present.
				 */
				const isMobileWidth = screen.width < 768
				if (isMobileWidth && !document.cookie.includes('useMobileSite=yes')) {
					setUseMobileSiteCookie(true)
				} else if (!isMobileWidth && !document.cookie.includes('useMobileSite=no')) {

class="body-text -prose -reset js-review-body js-collapsible-text" data-full-text-url="/s/full-text/viewing:475982287/" data-is-translatable="true" lang="en" > <p>What I find fascinating about <i>The Holdovers </i>isn’t so much the staggering breakthrough Dominic Sessa performance or Paul Giamatti loudly reminding us he’s one of the greatest to grace the screen or even Da’Vine Joy Randolph’s effortless command of every scene— these aspects are obvious, they are the stainless steel cogs that ensure <i>The Holdovers</i> runs smoothly. What I find fascinating is <i>why</i> so many audiences have accepted the film’s warm embrace— it’s a tangible reminder that we, as living human beings, all crave and deserve love. </p><p>Romantic love, platonic love, familial love. That sense of belonging never erodes and through its many moving parts, <i>The Holdovers </i>reminds us of that. Brilliant stuff.</p><p><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/houseofcinema/episodes/Ep--148--November-Recap-The-Marvels--The-Holdovers--Napoleon-e2cgj73" rel="nofollow">Podcast Ep: 148- November Recap</a></p> </div> <div class="viewing-actions"> <div class="review-actions"> <p class="like-link-target react-component" data-component-class="LikeComponent" data-likeable-identifier='{"lid":"5c7JmD","uid":"viewing:475982287","type":"viewing","typeName":"review"}' data-redacted="false" data-element-type="p" data-likes-page="/jaragon23/film/the-holdovers/likes/" data-format="count" data-count="11748" data-owner="JAragon23" > <span class="has-icon icon-16 icon-like"></span> </p> <button class="button-neue -text -small translation-button" hidden data-translation-control-for="5c7JmD" > <span class="label js-label"> Translate </span> </button> <div hidden class="translation-disclaimer js-translation-disclaimer"> Translated from <span class="js-language-name"></span> by <span class="js-translated-by"></span> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </article> </div>
